notes.title: Unicopia launch prize draw
notes.content:
Celebrating the launch of Unicopia, Squeaky Pig Studios' is pleased to announce the winner of the Unicopia Picade Prize Draw is [url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/Hairyz0r]Hairy[/url] for their darned cute reimagining of the Unicopia logo!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45128882/16b5391c64c2c066375de066fdc37ad8eddf9811.jpg[/img]
 
Well done, Hairy, and after squashing, squeezing and recompiling Unicopia for the Picade, please take good care of Cornelia in her natural home, a lovingly hand built arcade cabinet.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45128882/a29e5ecee260815e1f3775d35925f6f3877ce2ee.png[/img]
